info.description: OCRBase extracts printed text with Tesseract 5 and scores every word: the response carries the plain text in reading order, each word's bounding box and confidence, and a mean_confidence computed in code, so you can see the engine's ceiling before you build on it. Errors are named and structured - unsupported_format, file_too_large, no_text_detected, unsupported_language - never a bare 500. Handwriting is NOT supported and is labeled as such everywhere; this is print and typed documents, honestly scoped. Peak service memory during a full-page extraction was measured at 176.5 MB inside the 512 MB free-tier limit, and every response reports its own processing_ms.
